cases.caption: Original instrumental club house, 128 BPM, rolling groove, hypnotic minor-key color. Use a firm four-on-the-floor kick, crisp offbeat hats and a tight bass groove. Start with the complete drum and bass groove on beat one. First eight bars establish one memorable rhythmic hook; next eight bars vary its answer while keeping the same bass sound and pulse. Then a two-bar percussion rise, followed by a strong full-bass return with one new counter-rhythm. Keep the final four bars rhythmically stable for the next DJ blend. No ambient intro, drumless breakdown or fade-out. Keep the kick transient clear, the sub bass controlled and separate from the kick, consistent drum timbres, uncluttered mids and restrained highs. Short fills only at phrase ends. Energy 4 of 5. No vocals, borrowed melodies or artist imitation.
cases.label: acestep-v15-turbo: house instrumental
